email-recovery-description: Mothaladi o tee wa moamogedi yo mongwe le yo mongwe. Nyaka ka ID ya mošomiši. Diteng tša molaetša le mafelo a imeile a moamogedi ga di bontšhwe. Go emiša nakwana go swara melaetša ya bjale le ya nakong e tlago; Go tšwela pele go leka gape go romela melaetša ya mothalading gona bjale. Go khansela go tloša melaetša ye e tsentšwego mothalading go fihla nakong ya kgopelo. Ge go romela go swaregile, leka gape ka morago ga nakwana. Molaetša wo o šetšego o thomile go romelwa o ka se bušetšwe morago, gomme go romela mo go nago le dipoelo tše di sa kgonthišegego go ka boeletšwa. Go palelwa ga sa ruri le melaetša ye e fihleletšego tekanyo ya maiteko di dula di le gona gore di hlahlobje. Go leka gape melaetša ye e paletšwego go thoma modikologo o mofsa wa maiteko gomme go boloka go emišwa nakwana mo go šetšego go le gona.

Dikholomo di balwa ka maina a tšona a Seisemane (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ge akhaonto ya gago e šomiša polelo ye nngwe, pele o fetoše mothaladi wa dihlogo go Seisemane. Column e fetoga malokelelo gomme Lane ditsela; beng, ditaki, mmala, matšatši, ditshwaotshwao le dikgokagano tša motswadi di boloka mafelo a tšona, gomme Priority, Size, Type le dikholomo tše dingwe di fetoga mašemo a gago.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Go ClickUp, romela mešomo bjalo ka CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, goba go romela ga pono ya List goba Table le dikholomo ka moka), ke moka o kgomaretše CSV. Maemo a fetoga malokelelo, malokelelo a ClickUp a fetoga ditsela, gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata le mešomo-potlana, bao ba filwego mošomo, ditaki, matšatši, bohlokwa le nako.
import-board-instruction-csv: Kgomaretša Ditekanyetšo tše di Arogantšwego ka Diphefšana (CSV)/Ditekanyetšo tše di Arogantšwego ka Dithepo (TSV).
import-board-instruction-deck: Kgomaretša JSON ya boto ya NextCloud Deck (boto ye e nago le "stacks", mokgobo o mongwe le o mongwe o rwala "cards" tša wona). Mekgobo e ba mananeo gomme dikarata tša ba dikarata.
import-board-instruction-excel: Kgetha sepreadšiti sa .xlsx sa mokgwa wa WeKan (dikholomo tše di swanago le ntšho ya Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, matšatšikgwedi, mafelo a tlwaelo). Mothaladi wa pele ke hlogo.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ntšha faele ya .boardarchive polokelong ye e gateletšwego gomme o kgomaretše diteng tša board.jsonl ya boto, le mothaladi wa phetolelo goba ntle le wona. Sebopego sa go hlopha ponong ya boto se fetoga mananeo, dibopego tše dingwe tša kgetho di fetoga diswayo, dikarolo tša sengwalwa le mapokisi a go swaya di fetoga tlhalošo le lelokelelo la tlhahlobo, gomme ditshwayotshwayo di a bolokwa. Diswantšho le difaele tše di kgomareditšwego ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-issues: Kgomaretša lenaneo la JSON la ditaba tša __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ditaba di ba dikarata tše di hlophilwego ka mananeo a Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Kgomaretša JSON ya ntšho ya Kanboard: sedirišwa se se nago le "columns" (goba mešomo ye e rwelego column_name) le lenaneo la "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Dikholomo di ba mananeo gomme mešomo ya ba dikarata.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Go Kanri, bula Import & Export gomme o kgethe Export individual board (goba Export all data), ke moka o kgomaretše faele ya .json. Dikholomo di fetoga malokelelo gomme dikarata di fetoga dikarata, le tlhalošo, letšatši la mafelelo, ditaki le mebala; mešomo ya karata e fetoga lelokelelo la tlhahlobo. Go romelweng ga data ka moka, poto ya pele e a tsenywa.
import-board-instruction-leo: Kgomaretša sebopego sa Leo (faele ya .leo). Dikarolo tša maemo a godimo di fetoga malokelelo, dikarolo tše di lego ka fase ga tšona thwii di fetoga dikarata, gomme sengwalwa sa karolo se ba tlhalošo ya karata. Dikarolo tša maemo a go tsenelela di fetoga malokelelo a tlhahlobo. Dikarolo tše di swailwego di tsenywa bjalo ka tše di phethilwego.
import-board-instruction-linear: Go Linear, romela mathata bjalo ka CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, goba go romela ga pono), ke moka o kgomaretše CSV. Maemo a fetoga malokelelo, dihlopha di fetoga ditsela, gomme mathata a fetoga dikarata le yo a filwego mošomo, diswayo, matšatši, bothata bja motswadi, bohlokwa, kakanyo, projeke le modikologo.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Kgomaretša lelokelelo la mešomo ya markdown (mokgwa woo dithulusi tša markdown-kanban tša go swana le Obsidian Kanban di o šomišago): dihlogo tša "## Leina la lelokelelo", le dilo tša "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ka tlase. Dihlogo di fetoga malokelelo gomme dilo di fetoga dikarata.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Go MeisterTask, kgotla leina la projeke, kgetha Export project gomme o romele CSV, ke moka o e kgomaretše. Dikarolo di fetoga malokelelo gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata, le dingwalwana, letšatši la mafelelo, yo a filwego mošomo le ditaki; mešomo ye e feditšwego e boloka letšatši la go fetša. CSV ye e ngwaletšwego go tsenya ga MeisterTask ka boyona le yona e a šoma.
import-board-instruction-monday: Go monday.com, bula menyu ya poto, kgetha More actions le Export board to Excel (le dimpshafatšo le dilo-potlana ge o rata), ke moka o kgethe faele yeo ya .xlsx. Kholomo ya Status e fetoga malokelelo gomme dihlopha di fetoga ditsela; batho, matšatši, mothaladi wa nako le ditaki di boloka mafelo a tšona, dikholomo tše dingwe di fetoga mašemo a gago gomme dimpshafatšo di fetoga ditshwaotshwao.
import-board-instruction-notion: Go Notion, bula database bjalo ka letlakala ka moka, kgetha ••• le Export, kgetha Markdown & CSV, gomme o kgethe faele ya .zip ye e theollago, goba CSV e tee ya database go yona, goba o kgomaretše CSV yeo. Kholomo ye e bitšwago Status e fetoga malokelelo (ge e se gona, kholomo ya pele ye e lebelelagago bjalo ka kgetho e a dira, gomme pego ya go tsenya e bolela gore ke efe); methaladi e fetoga dikarata le sehlogo, ditaki bjalo ka diswayo, batho bjalo ka maloko, matšatši, le sengwalwa sa letlakala bjalo ka tlhalošo; dikholomo tše dingwe di fetoga mašemo a gago. Dikamano, diswantšho le ditlaleletšo ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Go Nullboard, bula poto, kgetha Export this board... go menyu, bula faele ya .nbx ka sehlophi sa sengwalwa gomme o kgomaretše diteng tša yona. Malokelelo a fetoga malokelelo gomme dingwalwana di fetoga dikarata: mothaladi wa pele wa ngwalwana ke sehlogo sa karata gomme tše dingwe ke tlhalošo. Ngwalwana ye e sa šongwago e hwetša leswao raw. Faele ye e nago le dipoto tše mmalwa e tsenya poto ya yona ya pele.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Go Obsidian, bula faele ya poto ya Kanban bjalo ka Markdown (goba bula faele ya .md ka sehlophi sa sengwalwa), ke moka o kgomaretše ka moka ga yona. Ditsela di fetoga malokelelo le mellwane ya tšona ya dikarata, dikarata di boloka ditaki, matšatši, bohlokwa, mašemo le lelokelelo la tlhahlobo, gomme Archive e fetoga dikarata tše di bolokilwego polokelong.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Kgomaretša JSON ya kgoboketšo ya diphuthelwana tša mošomo tša OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Maemo a ba mananeo gomme diphuthelwana tša mošomo tša ba dikarata.
import-board-instruction-opml: Kgomaretša kakaretšo ya OPML, bjalo ka ge Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq le tše dingwe di e romela. Dilo tša godimo di fetoga malokelelo, bana ba tšona ba fetoga dikarata gomme ngwalwana e ba tlhalošo, gomme dilo tše di tseneletšego kudu di fetoga malokelelo a tlhahlobo. Dilo tše di feditšwego di tsenywa bjalo ka tše di feditšwego.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Kgomaretša faele ya Org mode, bjalo ka ge Emacs, Orgzly goba Beorg di e ngwala. Dihlogo tša godimo di fetoga malokelelo gomme dihlogo tša legato la bobedi di fetoga dikarata. TODO le DONE, dintlha tša pele, ditaki, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE le CLOSED di a bolokwa, gomme mapokisi a go kgetha le dihlogo tše di tseneletšego di fetoga malokelelo a tlhahlobo.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Go Pivotal Tracker, bula tab ya MORE ya projeke gomme o kgethe Export CSV (goba kgetha dikanegelo gomme o kgethe Bulk Actions, CSV), ke moka o kgomaretše CSV. Boemo bjo bongwe le bjo bongwe bja kanegelo bo fetoga lelokelelo gomme dikanegelo di fetoga dikarata, le mohuta le diswayo, beng, mokgopedi, matšatši, ditshwaotshwao, mešomo le dipharišo; Estimate e fetoga Story points gomme dipoeletšo di fetoga disprint.
import-board-instruction-plane: Go Plane, bula Workspace Settings, kgetha Exports, romela diprojeke bjalo ka JSON, CSV goba Excel gomme o theolle faele ya .zip, ke moka o kgethe faele yeo, goba faele e tee ka gare ga yona, goba o kgomaretše JSON goba CSV. Maemo a fetoga malokelelo, diprojeke di fetoga ditsela, gomme mathata a fetoga dikarata le sešupo, motswadi, bao ba filwego mošomo, diswayo, matšatši, dikgokagano le ditshwaotshwao; bohlokwa, kakanyo, modikologo le mojule di fetoga mašemo a gago. Go romela ga Plane ga go na ditlhalošo goba ditlaleletšo, ka gona ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: Go Quire, bula menyu ya projeke gomme o kgethe Export CSV, ke moka o kgomaretše CSV. Maemo a fetoga malokelelo gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata, le mešomo-potlana bjalo ka dikarata tša bana, bao ba filwego mošomo, ditaki bjalo ka diswayo, matšatši a go thoma, a mafelelo le a go fetša, tlhalošo le bohlokwa bjalo ka lešemo la gago. Ditshwaotshwao le ditlaleletšo ga di gona go CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Go Redmine, bula Issues ya projeke, kgetha Also available in: CSV ka tlase ga lelokelelo, kgetha dikholomo (All columns, le Description) gomme o romele, ke moka o kgomaretše CSV. Redmine e reela dikholomo ka polelo ya gago, ka gona beakanya polelo ya gago go Seisemane go My account pele o romela. Boemo bjo bongwe le bjo bongwe bo fetoga lelokelelo gomme mathata a fetoga dikarata, le tracker bjalo ka leswao, yo a filwego mošomo, mongwadi, matšatši, mošomo wa motswadi le mathata a amanago; bohlokwa, legoro, phetolelo ye e nepilwego, nako ye e akantšwego, % Done le mašemo a gago di fetoga mašemo a gago.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Go Super Productivity, bula Settings, ke moka Sync & Backup, kgetha Export Data gomme o kgomaretše diteng tša faele ya sp-backup .json. Projeke ye nngwe le ye nngwe e fetoga tsela gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata go To Do, In Progress, Backlog goba Done, le dingwalwana, ditaki, letšatši la mafelelo, nako ye e šomišitšwego le mešomo-potlana; mešomo ye e bolokilwego polokelong e fetoga dikarata tše di bolokilwego polokelong.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Go Taiga, bula Admin > Project > Export gomme o theolle kopi ya projeke (pele o bule faele ya .json.gz), ke moka o kgomaretše JSON ya yona. Maemo a dikanegelo tša mošomiši a fetoga malokelelo, dikanegelo tša mošomiši di fetoga dikarata le mešomo ya tšona bjalo ka mešomo-potlana, di-epic le mathata di hwetša ditsela tša tšona, gomme disprint, ditaki, ditshwaotshwao le dika tša gago di tla le tšona. Ditlaleletšo ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Go Tasks.org, bula Settings, Backups gomme o kgethe Export tasks, ke moka o kgomaretše diteng tša faele yeo ya .json. Malokelelo a fetoga malokelelo gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata, le dingwalwana, ditaki, matšatši, ditshwaotshwao le mešomo-potlana; mešomo ye e feditšwego e boloka letšatši la go fetša, gomme bohlokwa bo fetoga lešemo la gago.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Kgomaretša sephetho sa task export: lenaneo la JSON goba mošomo o tee mothalading o mongwe le o mongwe. Mešomo ye e phethilwego e ya go Done, project le priority di fetoga diswayo, annotations e fetoga ditshwayotshwayo, gomme depends e fetoga go ithekga ka mešomo ye e thibelago.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Go Teamwork.com, tlatša thempoleiti ya go tsenya mešomo ya Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) gomme o e boloke bjalo ka .xlsx, ke moka o kgethe faele yeo. Malokelelo a mešomo a fetoga malokelelo gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata; mošomo wo o thomago ka -, # goba > o fetoga mošomo-potlana wa mošomo wo o lego ka godimo ga wona (--, ## goba >> legato le tee ka tlase). Bao ba filwego mošomo, matšatši le ditaki di boloka mafelo a tšona; Priority, Estimated time le Complete di fetoga mašemo a gago.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Go TickTick, bula Settings, Account, Backup & Import gomme o dire kopi ya polokego, ke moka o kgomaretše faele ya CSV. Lelokelelo le lengwe le le lengwe la TickTick le fetoga tsela gomme dikholomo tša lona di fetoga malokelelo; mešomo e boloka ditaki, matšatši, lelokelelo la tlhahlobo, bohlokwa le mešomo-potlana.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Kgomaretša faele ya todo.txt: mošomo o tee mothalading o mongwe le o mongwe, bjalo ka ge tirišo ya todo.txt le ditirišo tše di sepelelanago le yona di ngwala. Mešomo ye e phethilwego ("x") e ya karolong ye e phethilwego, +project le @context di fetoga dileibole, (A) e fetoga leibole ya bohlokwa, gomme due: le t: di fetoga matšatši a mafelelo le a go thoma.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Go Vikunja, bula Settings, kgetha Data Export gomme o theolle faele ya .zip ye e go romelago yona, ke moka o kgethe faele yeo, goba o kgomaretše data.json ye e lego ka gare ga yona. Dipakete tša Kanban di fetoga malokelelo gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata, le diswayo, bao ba filwego mošomo, matšatši, tlhalošo, malokelelo a mešomo bjalo ka malokelelo a tlhahlobo le ditshwaotshwao; bohlokwa, phesente ye e feditšwego le e feditšwe di fetoga mašemo a gago. Ditlaleletšo ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Go Wrike, romela projeke goba foltara go Excel, goba o tlatše thempoleiti ya go tsenya ya Excel ya Wrike, ke moka o kgethe faele yeo ya .xlsx. Methaladi ya foltara le ya projeke e fetoga ditsela, Status e fetoga malokelelo gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata, le Key, mošomo wa motswadi, bao ba filwego mošomo, matšatši a go thoma le a mafelelo, go ithekga le tlhalošo; Priority, Duration le dikholomo tše dingwe di fetoga mašemo a gago.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Kgomaretša JSON ya ntšho ya lenaneo la ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Magato a ba mananeo gomme dilo tša ba dikarata.

r-wrike-workflow-note: Phallo ya mošomo ya Wrike ke lelokelelo la maemo, le lengwe le le lengwe le le sehlopheng sa Active, Completed, Deferred goba Cancelled. Go romela go ngwala malokelelo a poto ye bjalo ka phallo e tee, e reetšwe ka poto, ka JSON yeo API ya Wrike e e bušetšago bakeng sa diphallo tša mošomo: hlama phallo yeo ya mošomo go Wrike pele o tsenya go romela ga Excel ga Wrike ga poto, gore maemo a yona a šomišwe. Go tsenya go bala JSON yeo e kgomareditšwego ka godimo, go tšwa go WeKan goba go GET /workflows ya Wrike, go poto ye e kgethilwego: boemo bjo bo se nago lelokelelo bo fetoga lelokelelo, gomme molao o swaya karata e feditšwe ge e išwa boemong bja Completed goba Cancelled, gomme e sa fela boemong bja Active goba Deferred. Melao ya Wrike ya go itiriša ga e kgone go romelwa go tšwa go Wrike.
